{{Quote|Artificial Intelligence worth shaving your head for.|BioTech advertisement|<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
The '''AJ^6 cyborg construct''', also known as the '''Borg Construct Aj^6''', was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant produced by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] prior to the onset of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Consumers and cyborg engineers continue to rate the Aj^6 as the best ever made. With the proliferation of new cyborg companies, with unproven theories and untested technology, we have to ask: Why take chances with your mind?|BioTech advertisement|<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition" />}}
[[File:Borg_Construct_AJ6_Top_Schematic.png|thumb|left|Top schematic of the Borg Construct Aj^6.]]
The Borg Construct Aj^6 was manufactured by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] and was an advanced [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] interface that allowed [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] to control [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems.<ref name="EGWT" /> It was one of the most sophisticated cyborg implants that was available on the commercial market. Designed to interface with large computer networks, the crescent-shaped device was attached to the wearer's head and was implanted against the skull.<ref name="NEGWT" /> [[Cyborg Nanothread Interface]]s connected the unit directly to the cyborg's mind<ref name="EGWT" /> using [[nanothread]]s that were sent into the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] to create a bridge with the implant's [[Biocomputer/Legends|biocomputer]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> Using the latest BioTech neurothread technology, the AJ^6 enabled a clear connection between the cyborg's brain and the information contained within the construct.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>

The Aj^6 incorporated a primary [[Processor/Legends|processor]] and several [[Data Retrieval Processor]]s, and was capable of storing millions of [[data screen unit]]s of information. Several ports were located on the outside of the unit, including [[Computer Interface Port]]s, [[Droid Interface Port]]s, and several [[Knowledge Cartridge Port]]s.<ref name="EGWT" /> The cyborg was able to program with greater ease using the standard data library built into the implant.<ref name="CRFG" /> [[Knowledge cartridge]]s could be placed in the latter ports that allowed the cyborg to assimilate the knowledge on the cartridges to learn information on specific subjects and procedures, allowing them to become an expert. [[Audio Enhancer]]s and a [[communications transceiver]] was also installed on the Aj^6.<ref name="EGWT" />

[[File:Borg_Construct_AJ6_Side_Schematic.png|thumb|right|Side schematic of the Borg Construct Aj^6.]]
The unit enhanced the cyborg's intelligence,<ref name="NEGWT" /> as well as increasing their logic and reasoning abilities. The Aj^6 allowed the cyborg to connect to any linked computer system, controlling them using mental commands. Data could be analyzed at the same time, and the computer operation speeds were increased twentyfold<ref name="EGWT" /> over that of an organic computer operator.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The effectiveness of the unit depended greatly on the computer systems it was linked to.<ref name="EGWT" />

The unit cost eighty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], while the surgery to fit the device cost an additional seventy thousand credits. A mistake during the procedure could result in brain damage or even [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="EGWT" /> Despite the advantages of the implant, the Aj^6 came under criticism since it was seen to limit a wearer's personality and suppress their emotions, and almost literally turned them into walking machines.<ref name="NEGWT" />

==History==
[[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was linked to the [[Computer Core]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Lobot was capable of adjusting any of the [[City/Legends|city's]] operations, as well as directing the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]] to deal with security issues.<ref name="EGWT" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|Crisis on Cloud City]]'' erroneously claims that the Aj^6 was produced by [[Bioniip Laboratories/Legends|Bioniip Laboratories]]. ''[[Hero's Guide]]'' lists this device as the AJ^6, as opposed to Aj^6, while the [[Cloud City Limited]] card "Cyborg Construct" lists it as Aj^g.
